_comment: docs/09 beat 1 and 5. Three profiles from ONE baseline, one variable at a time, assessed by the real engine under config/engine-policy.json. Regenerate with: cargo test --test ablation -- --ignored emit_comparison

profiles.name: Unproven
profiles.blurb: No demonstrated record. Capacity is bounded by history, because there is none to lend against.

profiles.name: Proven
profiles.blurb: A strong repayment record against a clean book. History opens the facility.

profiles.name: Concentrated
profiles.blurb: The same flawless record, against a dangerous book: thin equity, already levered, the rest in one shocked asset. Stress overrides the record.

profiles.name: Emerging
profiles.blurb: A partial record: some obligations repaid, not many. The limit is still set by history, but history has started to lift it.

profiles.name: Scarred
profiles.blurb: A good record with real defaults in it. Credit is not withdrawn -- the price rises. A record with a default is still a record.

profiles.name: Stormbound
profiles.blurb: A proven agent asking to buy into a violently volatile asset. The record is untouched; what it survives is not.

profiles.name: Indebted
profiles.blurb: A proven agent that has already drawn most of its facility. What it has EARNED is unchanged -- what it may still draw is what is left underneath the limit.

profiles.name: Unreadable
profiles.blurb: Evidence the engine will not stand behind: its repayment history is incomplete. It refuses to rate rather than guessing.
